title: Golden Clover
body:
The golden clover is a rare variant that is only obtainable during the St. Patricks event.

Description

The golden clover has been added during the St. Patricks event as an exclusive tree during v1.78.0. And will not spawn naturally outside of the event. the golden clover resembles a honey like texture and is transparent while logged, sanded, and planked.
